g.text: Sequence Diagram - VIS02 Building the Kitchen Room and Equipment
Precondition (usVIS01 SD 1, steps 1-4): the ACTIVE configuration was received from
GET /kitchen-configurations/active, passed parseActiveConfiguration and EVERY asset of "assets"
was preloaded into LoadedAssets. VIS02 never requests data, never reads a URL and has no layout of its own.
The construction of one element (procedural / imported) is detailed in sequence_diagram_element_construction.
